test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a code language, ‘FREQUENT’ is written as ‘6 - 18 - 5 - 17 - 21 - 5 - 14 - 20’ and ‘DANGER’ is written as ‘4 - 1 - 14 - 7 - 5 - 18’. How will ‘SOLITUDE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘FREQUENT’ is written as ‘6 - 18 - 5 - 17 - 21 - 5 - 14 - 20’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e226ebc084d6db7b0bc99c69b0b9d096cc0959cb6ff8295010a03c245b00757.png] 

‘DANGER’ is written as ‘4 - 1 - 14 - 7 - 5 - 18’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69f2945fad61830b4b4a80753712c5c305c8ad52581402af8e4fc24bcb2de07f.png] 

Similarly, ‘SOLITUDE’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2776019f980d09c607b0cbc8a42a72d8f26a4fee8269816c59ce9908ef730738.png] 

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
